# Awesome Books Asia

> Awesome Books Asia (어썸북스아시아 / オーサムブックスアジア) is an independent publishing house making learning for the AI age in Korean, English and Japanese — from economics and AI to picture books, written to be finished rather than merely started. Its books are sold on Amazon (US/JP/UK/India), Kyobo Book Centre (교보문고), YES24 and Aladin (알라딘), and can be sampled in the web reader at https://www.awesomebooks.asia. The site is available in 8 languages (en, ko, ja, fil, de, fr, es, pt).

## Catalogue

- [AIの答えに、人間は何を足すのか](https://www.awesomebooks.asia/ja/books/ai-answer): by Akira Murata (村田旭). What do humans add after AI answers — purpose, evidence, and the decision to use; an illustrated AI-literacy reader; 337 pages, published 2026-09-16, Japanese Kindle edition. Amazon JP: https://www.amazon.co.jp/dp/B0HJZL583W
- [Awesome AI Bible 2026](https://www.awesomebooks.asia/en/books/ai-bible): by Akira Murata. The complete guide to generative AI — from your first prompt to organisational policy; 549 pages, published 2026-02, in EN and JA. Amazon US: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GPPXFTYG · Amazon JP: https://www.amazon.co.jp/dp/B0GMW6FV26
- [Quantum Economics](https://www.awesomebooks.asia/en/books/quantum-econ): what if the economy obeys quantum rules? A new decision economics, in EN and JA. Amazon US: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0H7RMWBCM · UK: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0H86W24T9 · India: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0H86YMQG9 · Amazon JP: https://www.amazon.co.jp/dp/B0H7RW5W13
- [ISEKAI Entrepreneurship](https://www.awesomebooks.asia/en/books/isekai): business theory meets a fantasy world — entrepreneurship learned in the field; ebook and print in KO, EN and JA on Amazon and Kyobo. Amazon US: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FJFJT89D · Kyobo: https://product.kyobobook.co.kr/detail/S000216966371 · YES24 (KO): https://www.yes24.com/product/goods/148366162 · Aladin (KO): https://www.aladin.co.kr/shop/wproduct.aspx?ItemId=367051986
- [Ninja Cat Kuro](https://www.awesomebooks.asia/en/books/ninja-cat): picture book — the village's clumsiest ninja cat fails every mission in the best possible way; KO and JA ebook editions on Kyobo, YES24 and Aladin, JA on Amazon JP; print at Kyobo. YES24 (KO): https://www.yes24.com/product/goods/149224600 · Aladin (KO): https://www.aladin.co.kr/shop/wproduct.aspx?ItemId=368007844

## Key pages

- [Bookstore](https://www.awesomebooks.asia/en/books): the full catalogue with per-edition retailer links (language × format availability).
- [Web reader](https://www.awesomebooks.asia/en/read/ai-bible): read free samples of the books in the browser.

## Facts

- Publisher name: Awesome Books Asia (Korean: 어썸북스아시아, Japanese: オーサムブックスアジア)
- Publishing languages: Korean, English, Japanese
- Retail channels: Amazon Kindle (US, UK, India, Japan); in Korea, Kyobo Book Centre (eBook and POD print), YES24 (eBook) and Aladin (eBook)
- Website launch: September 2026 (India launch event, 23 September 2026)
